title: 49ers' Sam Okuayinonu has "bad injury" to his foot, hopes to play by end of season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers' Sam Okuayinonu has "bad injury" to his foot, hopes to play by end of season
sources.description: When 49ers defensive lineman Sam Okuayinonu hurt his foot in the final practice before the team flight to Australia, there was hope that he could make a later flight and still play in the opener.
